name: Hipster
bio: Pranav Raj is known professionally by his stage name Hipzster, is a popular Indian actor and YouTuber predominantly working in the Malayalam film industry. He began his acting career with the 2024 release 'Aavesham'.

credits.title: Cosmic Samson
credits.overview: Aspiring filmmaker working as a pizza delivery guy whose ordinary life takes an extraordinary turn when mysterious forces unlock hidden superpowers within him, pulling him into a secret fantasy world and launching him on an epic, action-packed adventure beyond anything he has ever imagined.

credits.title: Kattalan
credits.overview: Power-hungry forces clash in the Ivory cartel war-a fierce story of control, vengeance, and survival where compassion vanishes and only the ruthless endure.

credits.title: Aavesham
credits.overview: Three college freshmen in Bangalore befriend an eccentric gangster to get revenge on their senior bullies.
